tools.name: get_portal_statistics
tools.description: Portal-wide totals (users, courses, categories, groups, branches, monthly active users) and settings (signup method, date format, branch limit). A good first call. GET /api/v2/statistics.

tools.name: get_timeline
tools.description: Recent portal events (logins, user/course/group/branch changes, course completions, certificates...) with the user and related course/group/branch/unit. Filter by event type (e.g. course_completion, user_login_user, user_create_user) and a date range. GET /api/v2/timeline.

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: List the portal's users (id, login, name, email, user type, status, registration, last login), paginated. Filter by keyword (name/login/email), exact email or login, status, branch, group, last-updated range or a custom field value. GET /api/v2/users.

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Full profile of one user: login, name, email, user type, status, timezone, locale, credits, custom fields, deactivation date. GET /api/v2/users/{id}.

tools.name: list_user_courses
tools.description: The courses a user is enrolled in, with their role (learner/instructor), enrollment and completion dates, completion status and percentage, score and total time. GET /api/v2/users/{id}/courses.

tools.name: list_user_groups
tools.description: The groups a user belongs to (id, name). GET /api/v2/users/{id}/groups.

tools.name: list_user_branches
tools.description: The branches a user belongs to (id, name). GET /api/v2/users/{id}/branches.

tools.name: list_user_certificates
tools.description: Certificates a user has earned (course, issue and expiration dates, download/public URLs). GET /api/v2/users/{id}/certificates.

tools.name: get_course_progress
tools.description: One user's status in one course: enrolled or not, role, completion status, completion percentage and date, score, total time, last viewed unit and certificate. GET /api/v2/course-progress?user_id=&course_id=.

tools.name: list_courses
tools.description: List the portal's courses (id, name, code, category, status, price, dates, catalog visibility), paginated. Optionally only courses with a given custom course field value. GET /api/v2/courses.

tools.name: get_course
tools.description: Full details of one course: description, category, status, price, capacity, time limit, start/expiration, settings. GET /api/v2/courses/{id}.

tools.name: list_course_users
tools.description: Users enrolled in a course with their enrollment date, completion status, completion percentage, completion date and total time: the course's progress report. GET /api/v2/courses/{id}/users.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The course category tree (id, parent, name, price, children), paginated. GET /api/v2/categories.

tools.name: list_learning_paths
tools.description: Learning paths (sequences of courses) with status, category, price, dates and rules, paginated. GET /api/v2/learning-paths.

tools.name: list_groups
tools.description: List the portal's groups (id, name, description, branch, price, key redemptions), paginated. GET /api/v2/groups.

tools.name: get_group
tools.description: Details of one group: name, description, branch, group key, max key redemptions, price. GET /api/v2/groups/{id}.

tools.name: list_group_users
tools.description: Members of a group (id, login, name, email, user type, status, last login), paginated. GET /api/v2/groups/{id}/users.

tools.name: list_branches
tools.description: List the portal's branches (sub-portals: id, name, URL, description, active), paginated. GET /api/v2/branches.

tools.name: get_branch
tools.description: Details of one branch: URL, title, theme, default locale/timezone/user type/group, signup and verification settings, e-commerce settings. GET /api/v2/branches/{id}.

tools.name: list_branch_users
tools.description: Users in a branch (id, login, name, email, user type, status, last login), paginated. GET /api/v2/branches/{id}/users.

tools.name: create_user
tools.description: WRITE: create a new LEARNER account in the portal (TalentLMS may email the user, depending on the portal's settings). tools.name: enroll_user_in_course
tools.description: WRITE: enroll an existing user in a course (as a learner). Returns the assigned role. POST /api/v2/enrollments.

tools.name: add_user_to_group
tools.description: WRITE: add an existing user to a group, which also enrolls them in the group's courses. Set enroll_to_courses to enroll synchronously. POST /api/v2/group-memberships.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "create_user" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_users, get_user, list_user_certificates, list_group_users, list_branches, get_branch, list_branch_users · Public sink: list_users, get_user, list_group_users, list_branch_users, create_user, enroll_user_in_course, add_user_to_group · Destructive: get_portal_statistics.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_users, get_user, list_user_certificates, list_group_users, list_branches, get_branch, list_branch_users · Public sink: list_users, get_user, list_group_users, list_branch_users, create_user, enroll_user_in_course, add_user_to_group · Destructive: get_portal_statistics

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
